question: What is the name of the highest peak of Indian Garhwal Himalayas located in Chamoli district of Uttarakhand state with a height of 7,816 metres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanda Devi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanda Devi** is the **highest peak of the Indian Garhwal Himalayas** located in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand state with a height of **7,816 metres**.
 
• It is the second highest mountain in India and the 23rd highest peak in the world.
 
• Nanda Devi is part of the Greater Himalayas and is renowned for its challenging climbing routes and breathtaking scenery.
 
• The Nanda Devi National Park, which surrounds the peak, is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and a popular destination for trekkers and nature enthusiasts.
 
• The first successful ascent of Nanda Devi was made by a British-American expedition in 1936.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nanda Devi holds significant cultural and religious importance to the local communities in Uttarakhand.
 
• Due to its fragile ecosystem, the Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve was established to protect the region's unique flora and fauna.
 
• In 1982, the area was closed to climbers and trekkers to preserve its natural environment, although some parts have since been reopened under strict regulations.
 
• The peak is named after the Hindu goddess Nanda Devi, who is revered as the patron deity of the region.
 
• Efforts are continuously made to balance ecological preservation with sustainable tourism in the area.
